heading: Respond to the tenant's application
daysNotice: You have 28 days from the tenant's application date if you want to submit a response to the tribunal.
noFee: There is no fee to send a response.
answersSavedAutomatically: Your answers get saved automatically. You can review and edit your answers before you submit your response.
responseSharedWithTenant: We will share your response and any attachments with the tenant and any representatives.
wantCopy: You may want to have a copy of the tenant's application with you.
viewTenantsApplication: View the tenant's application (opens in a new tab)
showTenantsAnswers: We will also show you the answers provided in their application in this response form. You can tell us if you disagree with anything, give your reasons, and upload any evidence you have.
confirmBasicDetails: We will first ask you to confirm some basic details the tenant gave in their application, including:
